method_and_model_limits: No pin-range check exists in the stock state-write body; bank-7 and upper-pin alias vectors are address diagnostics only.
The raw-u32 adapter is required for modeling arbitrary stock R1 values because the stock entry performs UXTB; the byte-typed C entry is intended for valid API callers.
GPIO command effects and output-active mask are synthetic; no physical pad/electrical, clock, mux or complete radio lifecycle evidence is claimed.
The radio helper is reconstructed; raw board config 3 and caller flow are authenticated, but no end-to-end shutdown safety claim is made.
